Fermenta Biotech Shares List on NSE, Expanding Investor Access

Fermenta Biotech's shares began trading on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) on [Date]. This listing allows the company to have a dual-exchange presence, alongside its existing listing on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE). The move is intended to broaden investor access to the company's stock. Fermenta Biotech is involved in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors.
